_comment: Claude Desktop config for a HAAP no-wrap MCP client (auto-wrap plan U4b, ADR-0031 Lane B).
Claude Desktop SPAWNS this command and speaks MCP over its stdio. Nothing in Claude
Desktop is Hawcx-aware and no SDK is imported: every tools/call it makes is intercepted
by the attach proxy, which mints a per-call HAAP token out-of-process and attaches it at
params._meta.hawcx before forwarding. The model never holds a reusable credential.
Replace <> placeholders. See docs/MCP_NO_WRAP_CLIENTS.md for what each one is.
